prior_importants.description: Docs and ADR 0200 say an `autoCompactWindow` or other rule edit reaches a window at its next respawn, but `relaunchWindow` reuses the stored `compiled/settings.json` and recompiles nothing, so a respawn keeps the old window (or none).

process_issues.description: The delta is docs only (docs/03-profiles.md and ADR 0200), so only docs and conventions ran. review-correctness skipped: no logic changed, and the docs reviewer checked the prose against the code (recompileSessionProfile, the autoCompactWindow compile sites, ADRs 0115 and 0183). review-security, review-context, review-simplicity and review-guards skipped: the delta touches no trust boundary, infra surface or source file and adds no construct. review-spec skipped: no spec source. review-workflow-safety skipped: no workflow change. review-maintainability skipped: not on the standard roster.
